title: Multilingual seed leaves the fast year stale after creating days
reasoning: The main seed command creates Day rows and then explicitly saves the related Fast so its derived year field is updated. The multilingual seed command creates a Fast before any Day exists, then creates a Day but never saves the Fast again. Based on the owned-file pattern, the resulting multilingual Fast can retain a missing or stale year, breaking behavior that filters or displays fasts by year.
recommendation: After creating all Day rows for the multilingual fast, call `fast.save(update_fields=["year"])` or use the same helper/path as the main seed data for derived Fast fields.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for either management command, and the existing excerpt only shows manual seed behavior rather than assertions around derived Fast fields.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a management-command test that runs `seed_multilingual_data`, reloads the created Great Lent Fast, and asserts its year matches the created Day date's year.
minimumFixScope: Update `hub/management/commands/seed_multilingual_data.py` to refresh derived Fast fields after creating days and add a focused command test.
